headline: Anthropic Selects JPMorgan to Lead Retail Distribution for US IPO
summary: AI startup Anthropic has selected JPMorgan Chase to manage retail share distribution for its planned initial public offering in the United States, Bloomberg reported.
why: Anthropic is one of the premier venture-backed foundation model developers globally; its eventual public listing serves as a major valuation benchmark for the AI sector.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co
impacts.why: Leading syndicate tranches on high-profile technology IPOs generates substantial underwriting fee revenue.
